accommodation.stay.title: Stay at Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram
accommodation.stay.intro: Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram provides peaceful and spiritual accommodation facilities for visiting devotees in Ayodhya. The stay experience is simple, disciplined, and spiritually enriching, designed to complement your pilgrimage to this sacred land.
accommodation.stay.sadhak.title: Sadhak / Ashram Rooms
accommodation.stay.sadhak.desc: Simple and clean rooms for spiritual seekers and devotees on a spiritual journey
accommodation.stay.standard.title: Devotee Standard Rooms
accommodation.stay.standard.desc: Comfortable accommodation for families and groups visiting for darshan and satsang
accommodation.stay.guest.title: Guest / Special Rooms
accommodation.stay.guest.desc: Enhanced facilities for extended stays and special occasions

accommodation.booking.title: Booking Information
accommodation.booking.intro: To book your stay at Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram, please contact us in advance to check availability and make arrangements. We welcome devotees from all over India and abroad to experience the spiritual atmosphere of Ayodhya and participate in our daily activities.
accommodation.booking.call.title: 📞 Call Us
accommodation.booking.call.desc: Speak with our coordinators for booking
accommodation.booking.email.title: ✉️ Email Us
accommodation.booking.visit.title: 📍 Visit Us
accommodation.booking.visit.desc: Walk-ins are welcome subject to availability
accommodation.guidelines.title: Guidelines for Guests
accommodation.guidelines.checkin.title: Check-in & Check-out Times
accommodation.guidelines.checkin.desc: Please coordinate with ashram administration for arrival and departure times. Early check-in or late check-out may be arranged based on availability.
accommodation.guidelines.documents.title: Required Documents
accommodation.guidelines.documents.desc: Valid ID proof is required for registration. Please carry original identification documents during your visit.
accommodation.guidelines.discipline.desc: We maintain a spiritually disciplined environment. Please respect ashram timings, participate in prayers if possible, and maintain the sanctity of the space.
accommodation.guidelines.prohibited.desc: Alcohol, tobacco, non-vegetarian food, and other prohibited items are not allowed within ashram premises.
accommodation.cta.title: Book Your Spiritual Stay
accommodation.cta.desc: Experience the peace and devotion of Ayodhya with us at Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram
